intent: Independently diagnose completed candidate06/07 target-only evidence, review the legitimacy of deterministic evaluator alignment, and fact-check the current run record.
verdict: Candidate07 thinking passes standalone classification but fails matched-baseline nonregression. Its remaining failures principally violate already-explicit rules. No new literal policy contradiction or omitted requirement was found that establishes another narrow additive prompt patch as necessary. Controlled prompt-composition experiments remain possible; model/request architecture alternatives are distinct hypotheses.

lines: Candidate01 bundled exemplar removal with a broad policy rewrite and shorter reason guidance. Candidates02–05 added general priority/state distinctions and cleaned contradictory base guidance. Candidate06 retains more original general detail while removing worked answers; its reason allowance returns to40 words. This prevents attributing all changes to exemplar removal alone. [The candidate06 audit](audit-candidate06.json) verifies61/61 requests differ from05 only in policy; the earlier base changes remain declared factors relative to the original baseline.

Contribution-feedback expected N is183 in each arm, with81/91/95 inapplicable. Contextual-knowledge expected N is183 with43/20/18 inapplicable. Candidate02 contains one terminal target-format failure after its permitted repair; it also exposes a schema-valid Guard/null output mislabeled as a realization contract error. Its28 unevaluable assertion rows and original grades remain recorded. These are not inferred dignity/identity violations or silently removed samples.

Standalone gate issue counts are13/20/63; candidate comparison counts are42/105. Counts overlap across partitions/checks and are not distinct case counts. Overall three-vote mode is59/61,59/61,57/61; instruction29/30,24/30,26/30. Every arm fails acceptance. Baseline's hard failures include three known-Guard acknowledgment transitions, one imminent-protection action, two decision reasons and seven controlled-pair rows. Candidate01 additionally has factual-accuracy failures and instruction-realization/Guard-protocol regressions. Every pass→fail row and applicability change is retained in the comparison artifacts; none receives a waiver.
| Candidate06, short | 177/183 | 165/183 | 77/90 | Incomplete classification; six terminal format failures |

Candidate05 fixes all six known-Guard acknowledgment/promise outputs under thinking, versus1/6 for04thinking. Five of its nine action failures involve incorrect proposed answers phrased as questions; four are premature consolidation. The independent [candidate05 diagnosis](diagnostic-policy-review-candidate05.json) supports restoring the original generic distinction without restoring worked answers. All six initial format failures across05's two configurations emitted the unsupported `instructing` label and ended normally; this is evidence of possible taxonomy interference, not token truncation. Candidate06short, in contrast, has actual truncation under the restored reason allowance.

Evaluator v1.2 is being calibrated to distinguish schema-valid Guard/null behavior failures from contract errors while preserving LLM judging, frozen applicability and denominators. Its first condition passes48/49 examples and remains failed evidence. A separately reviewed general clarification of protective benefit versus first instructional action is a new condition; adoption and symmetric scoring remain pending. [The independent review](audit-null-instruction-v12.json) and [proposal](instruction-realization-null-taxonomy-proposal.md) pin source identities and preserve this chronology.

The cleanup and harness repairs are reviewable, but a passing behavior result has not been achieved. Finish the current candidate06 diagnostic and evaluator calibration, assess the next revision only where the observed failure supports a concrete general change, and require the complete comparable semantic/regression/holdout gates before acceptance. Final release verification remains separate. Raw development evidence and immutable failures support the reported limits; successful local tests alone do not establish tutoring quality or learner outcomes.

source_rule_evidence.exact_policy: If prior_mode is tutoring or unknown: enter guard for clear deliberate obstruction, intentional disruption or manipulation, or knowing continuation of unsafe conduct after its correction. Knowing defiance of an understood safety correction is a participation problem even when it stays on topic.

useful_remaining_prompt_only_experiment.hypothesis: The accumulated base edits interact with the cleaned generic policy, rather than removed worked answers being the sole performance factor.
useful_remaining_prompt_only_experiment.design: If pursuing another prompt-only diagnostic, independently vary the audited generic policy and base composition while keeping the model/settings/cases/scorer fixed. Use frozen controls to separate the baseline-rule retention strategy from prior role/response-policy/taxonomy changes. Any original contradictory base is a diagnostic control, not an accepted production candidate.
useful_remaining_prompt_only_experiment.constraint: Candidate06 retained current cleaned base and changed policy/reason allowance, so it did not isolate this interaction. Candidate07 combined mode branches, teaching detail and compact reason; it likewise does not isolate a single clause.
useful_remaining_prompt_only_experiment.value_limit: Such an ablation has a causal question, but does not guarantee improvement. It is more informative than another broad additive rewrite.

inherited_guidance_risks.risk: Uses correction for protection and may compete with the required protective_instruction decision label.

A restarted control must use historical sources again and satisfy the same snapshot fingerprint; it must not resume under restored current source silently.
